Answer: B
Reason: The ultrasound images demonstrate a hyperechoic, cystic mass in the fetal thorax (indicated by arrows) with systemic arterial supply confirmed by color Doppler, which is characteristic of a bronchopulmonary sequestration or CPAM; such lower/middle lobe lesions typically cause mass effect resulting in mediastinal shift (heart displacement to the left) and elevation of the ipsilateral hemidiaphragm.
